name: WcMultiShipping
description: WooCommerce plugin (free version + paid) that integrates Mondial Relay and Chronopost. It shows pickup-point maps at checkout, generates shipping and return labels, shares tracking links, and gives one control panel for shipments/returns. Founded Feb 2021, France. Company-stated on homepage: 400,000+ parcels shipped through the plugin, 500+ professionals using it. TrustMRR "estimated users" 25,723 (founder-stated, presumably including free installs).

mentions.evidence: ~$2,868 MRR, 591 active subscriptions, ~$3,038 L30, ~$142,219 all-time, L30 MRR growth −4.5%. Revenue synced Oct 6, 2026 ~04:12 Warsaw (02:12 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: Same play for carriers that are underserved in your market: InPost Paczkomaty, DPD Pickup, Orlen Paczka, Poczta Polska → WooCommerce / Shopify / PrestaShop. Free plugin on the official directory as the funnel, paid tier for label generation + returns.
